sheet_log.title: EXTERIOR ELEVATIONS - OPTION 01
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-201 shows four exterior elevations (North, South, East, West) for an industrial building for Crow Holdings, located on Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. Scales vary: West and East elevations at 1"=20'-0"; North and South elevations at 1"=40'-0". Building features tilt-up concrete panels with painted texture coating finishes, aluminum storefront curtain wall entries, overhead dock doors, pre-engineered canopies, and pre-finished metal coping/gutters/downspouts. Glass schedule provides three glazing types (A, B, C) all 1" insulated with Low-E coating, U=0.38, SHGC=0.26. Exact quantities of doors, windows, and storefront openings require counting from larger-scale drawings. Job No. shown as partially visible. Issue date 01/APR 2021. Sheet marked NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION.

sheet_log.title: MISC. DETAILS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-401 is an architectural miscellaneous details sheet for Crow Holdings Industrial, Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. Sheet is marked NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION. Contains 13 numbered details covering: dock leveler sections (future), ramp rail/guardrail sections, stair plan/section/rail details, Z-guard detail, bollard detail, fire riser/electrical panel protection, and enlarged ramp plan. All dock leveler work is designated FUTURE and should be noted as deferred/allowance scope. Quantities for guardrail, handrail, bollards, and open metal grate treads cannot be counted from this detail sheet alone - refer to floor plans and elevations for counts and lengths. All structural elements (footings, slabs, retaining walls) cross-reference structural drawings.
